name: SPOSCOR Basketball
author: powereight

sections.description:
SPOSCOR Basketball is a dedicated basketball plugin built on top of SPOSCOR Core. It adds basketball-specific features like quarter-by-quarter scoreboards, starting lineups, and game highlights — all designed to publish your game results quickly and beautifully.

Perfect for local basketball clubs, amateur teams, school clubs, and anyone who wants a simple yet professional way to display basketball scores on their WordPress site.

Why SPOSCOR Basketball?

  • 5 minutes to publish. Just enter scores and paste a shortcode.
  • Quarter-by-quarter scoreboard. Q1-Q4 plus overtime.
  • Overtime support. Add OT periods per game as needed.
  • Mobile-first admin. Enter scores from the gym on your phone, one-handed.
  • Beautiful display. Modern card design that looks great on any theme.

Features

  • Unlimited games
  • Quarter-by-quarter scoreboard (Q1-Q4 + OT)
  • Starting lineup (PG / SG / SF / PF / C + substitutes)
  • Game highlights (3-pointer, dunk, free throw, foul, and more) with per-play team, period, clock and player
  • 6 display themes (Light / Dark / Mono / Pro / Studio / Minimal)
  • Voice input for scores (free)
  • Multilingual: English, Japanese, Spanish

Pro Features ($39/year)

  • Unlimited tournaments (leagues & knockout brackets)
  • Standings tables with FIBA-style tiebreakers
  • Full design customization (colors & sizes)
  • OBS streaming view for live broadcasts
  • Lineup bulk paste from Excel / Google Sheets
  • Priority support

Requires SPOSCOR Core

This plugin needs the free “SPOSCOR Core” plugin to work. Install and activate SPOSCOR Core first.

Pricing

SPOSCOR Basketball comes in two plans: a free version (everything above) and Pro at $39/year, which adds unlimited tournaments, standings tables, full design customization, OBS streaming, and lineup bulk paste.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the free “SPOSCOR Core” plugin.
  2. Upload the SPOSCOR Basketball plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate SPOSCOR Basketball through the Plugins screen.
  4. Go to Basketball, add a game, enter the score, and paste the shortcode into any post or page.
sections.faq:
Does this work on its own?

No. SPOSCOR Basketball requires the free SPOSCOR Core plugin, which provides the shared engine and settings.

Can I show overtime?

Yes. The scoreboard supports Q1-Q4 plus overtime periods, which you can add per game.

Can I run a league or tournament?

Yes, with the Pro plan. The free plan includes one tournament; Pro unlocks unlimited tournaments, standings tables, and knockout brackets.

What shortcodes are available?

[sposcor_scorecard id=”123″] shows the full game card. [sposcor_result id=”123″] shows a compact result. Tournament and standings shortcodes are available with Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.9.1

  • Changed: all function, variable, and hook names now use a unique sposcor_basketball_ prefix

  • Fixed: admin styles could be overridden by another SPOSCOR sport plugin, changing the highlight row layout

  • Updated the bundled Freemius SDK to 2.13.4

  • Fixed: the auto-refresh toggle on match pages did nothing when more than one scorecard was on the page

  • Fixed: front-end scripts were attached to a shared handle and could fail to load, which stopped the refresh buttons from working

  • Improved: output escaping now uses wp_kses() with an explicit allow-list
  • Fixed: refresh buttons on tournament and standings views did not update the timestamp (Pro)
  • Fixed: design customization and streaming settings appeared on sports without a Pro license
  • Fixed: tournament features appeared on sports without a Pro license when another sport had one
  • Fixed: refresh and auto-refresh buttons on tournament and standings views (Pro)
  • Fixed: Pro features could disappear when another SPOSCOR sport plugin was active on the same site
  • Fixed: the license activation and account screens were registered outside the plugin menu, which caused a PHP notice and an access error after activating a license
  • Fixed: a PHP notice on WordPress 6.7 and later caused by translations being loaded before the init action
  • Improved: tournament grid layout now wraps to a single column on narrow screens (Pro)

1.7.42

  • Fixed design preview showing a stale color for settings hidden on this sport; they now follow the selected theme (Pro).

1.7.41

  • Streaming view now reflects changes to team abbreviations, logos, emoji, colors, venue, and tournament name without a manual reload (Pro).

1.7.40

  • Fixed the design settings preview falling back to theme preset colors for fields hidden on this sport (Pro).
  • Fixed the OBS Stream tab occasionally not appearing on the settings screen (Pro).

1.7.27

  • Design settings preview restored to the original working behavior (Pro).

1.7.26

  • Fixed the design settings preview by restoring the original color-input-first initialization (Pro).

1.7.25

  • Fixed the design settings preview reverting to the theme colors after saving (Pro).

1.7.24

  • Aligned Freemius configuration (slug and premium slug) with the dashboard.

1.7.23

  • WordPress.org compliance: separated Pro design logic, renamed to SPOSCOR Basketball, split Plugin/Author URIs, and hardened against double activation.

1.7.22

  • Highlight types: 3PT/2PT/FT/DUNK/AST/REB/BLK/STL/FOUL/TF plus Timeout, Substitution and Other.
  • Restored quarter label (Qtr), 4-quarter minimum, and captain marker.

1.7.21

  • Restored the captain (star) marker in the starting lineup (admin input and front-end C column).

1.7.20

  • Removed the baseball batting-hand and average columns from the starting lineup.

1.7.19

  • Removed the baseball ball/strike/out count and base-runner diamond from the top score area.

1.7.18

  • Tournament and league match cards now stack into a single column on mobile instead of overflowing.

1.7.17

  • Removed the baseball-only “Pitcher Record Row Background” option from the design settings.

1.7.16

  • Match cards now read quarter scores from the game when not stored on the tournament, so Q1-Q4 always appear.

1.7.15

  • Tournament and league match cards now show quarter-by-quarter scores (Q1-Q4 + OT).

1.7.14

  • Removed the baseball-only Pitchers section from Display Settings and the Settings page.

1.7.13

  • Removed the baseball-only Live Count URL from the OBS panel; basketball shows Main Score and Scoreboard URLs only.

1.7.12

  • Removed the duplicate PTS column next to the total (R) column on the scoreboard.

1.7.11

  • Scoreboard now stops adding periods at OT5 (Q1-Q4 + OT1-OT5).

1.7.10

  • Scoreboard headers now show Q1-Q4 and OT1-OT5 instead of 1,2,3.

1.7.9

  • Highlights use quarter + minute (Q1 3′) with player and event type, matching the established front-end layout.

1.7.8

  • Rebuilt on the shared SPOSCOR architecture (self-contained tournament, settings, and OBS layers bundled with the plugin).
  • Quarter-by-quarter scoreboard with overtime.
  • Starting lineup (PG/SG/SF/PF/C + substitutes).
  • Basketball highlights with period, clock, team, type, player and assist.
  • FIBA-style standings tiebreakers (Pro).
  • Compatible with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of SPOSCOR Basketball.
  • Quarter-by-quarter scoreboard with overtime.
  • Starting lineup (PG/SG/SF/PF/C + substitutes).
  • Basketball highlights with period, clock, team, type, player and assist.
  • FIBA-style standings tiebreakers (Pro).
  • Shared tournament, settings, and OBS streaming layers.
